wa_magic_bus.notes: HELD: parking_pass (Northwest Forest Pass) - no official page states a pass for the Eight-Mile trailhead; the Mountaineers route page says 'Parking Permit Required: None' (not official). The MBS passes page only says a pass may be needed at developed sites. HELD: descent (MP alone: rappel from the second anchors, one 70 m rope comfortable, 60 m needs knotted ends). Road: FR 2060 (Clear Creek Road) - the MBS alerts list (32 alerts, read 2026-11-18) names no closure on 2060/2065, but absence is not evidence, so no road object is written. Official trail page: 3.3 mi south of the Darrington RD office on the Mountain Loop Hwy, right on FR 2060 opposite Clear Creek Campground, 8 mi to the trailhead; MP and the Mountaineers say about 5-6.5 mi and a right fork onto FR 2065 - mileage disputed. The Mountain Loop Highway winter closure (Bedal Campground to Barlow Pass, from Nov 16) is well south of the Clear Creek turnoff and does not affect this approach. No pins: OSM has no parking or trailhead feature at the Eight-Mile trailhead, and the area coordinate is MP's.
